description: One manually researched point estimate of injury-related future missed regular-season games, Weeks 4-18, before Week 3 Monday Night Football. Estimates are modeling judgments, not medical predictions or confirmed return dates. Empty arrays mean no additional injury absence is expected. A null estimatedReturnWeek means no return projected through Week 18, not necessarily a confirmed season-ending injury. Week 3 and earlier games are excluded. Known team byes are excluded using the official 2026 NFL bye schedule: https://www.nfl.com/news/2026-nfl-schedule-release-every-team-bye-week (publication date not displayed; accessed 2026-09-28), cross-checked against https://www.footballguys.com/article/2026-nfl-schedule-bye-weeks. Only the current injury episode and current clearance news inform the estimates. Status strings preserve the supplied snapshot except cleared players. No future injuries or healthy scratches are projected.
